title: Deliciousness is in the details

location.extent: Complete local video; PNG is first-frame poster

slide_intent: Frame moving imagery within a stable composition so motion attracts attention without obscuring a message.
strategic_value: The dish-derived hexagon can connect Sweetgreen’s environmental imagery with its food system.
demonstration: Blueberries surround a six-sided window of moving clouds; the headline stays at top left and wordmark and Read More control remain below.
practical_value: Use a fixed content frame to contain motion while preserving a clear headline and action.

content_islands.name: Headline
content_islands.spec: Place the two-line statement at upper left.

content_islands.name: Framed clouds
content_islands.spec: Center the hexagonal moving sky and overlap blueberries around its edges.

content_islands.name: Footer
content_islands.spec: Keep wordmark at lower left and outlined Read More control at lower right.

reference_purposes.Application: The clip applies the hexagonal frame to moving sky content in a promotional composition.
reference_purposes.Expression: Moving clouds contrast with static blueberries, green type and a pale field.
